sites.why: Rule 2: streaming chat.completions on an AsyncOpenAI client built per message (line 156) with base_url = config['providers'][provider]['base_url'], where provider is the prefix of the runtime-selected '<provider>/<model>' string (first key of config.yaml models, switchable by admins via /model). The base URL comes from a user-defined providers map in config.yaml (shipped entries: openrouter, openai, x-ai, google, azure-openai, lmstudio, ollama, vllm), so it is a base URL chosen from a user-defined object at runtime. Key is provider_config api_key (resolved from env via *_env, default 'sk-no-key-required'), i.e. operator config, not per-user. Model is runtime (shipped config models: openai/gpt-5.5 [catalog id], openrouter/~anthropic/claude-opus-latest, ollama/llama4); extra_headers/extra_query/extra_body come from config.
